tickets.thesis: ICICIBANK has the highest debate conviction (7/10, 'tradeable') and is news-confirmed bullish via a positive Q1 update and bond sale plans. The scanner flags a 20d breakout above 1426.50 with normal volume confirmation, entry/stop/targets all derived from live ATR. Risk per share is ~₹34.65 (~2.4%); with ₹100k paper equity we size to 4 shares (~₹5,706, ~5.7% of book) to keep risk well under the 1R cap. T1 ₹1472.70 (~3.2%) and T2 ₹1495.80 (~4.9%) give a favorable ~2:1 R:R against the stop. Setup matches the 20d breakout playbook already stored in memory.
